title: 第9章 居然记得第10章 怎么没死在那里
slug: 恶毒师妹失忆后师兄们悔疯了
content_zh:
苏虞垂眸，懒得看他，语气讥讽：“难道你将我丢下去的时候，就没想过我会受伤吗？”
“难道你不知道……我最害怕蛇了吗？”
少女的声音很轻，让人不知道是在单纯地反问，还是在倾诉自己的委屈。
其实第二句话只是苏虞的试探。
没想到江凌寒真的愣住了。
这件事，他当然是知道的。他甚至还记得，小时候他们总喜欢在后山去摘果子吃。
虽然都已经辟谷了，但口腹之欲却还是在的。
当时小苏虞被一条无毒的小青蛇吓得嗷嗷大哭，最后果子也不要了，只拼命缩在他身后，让他保护她。
他就摸了摸她的头，说——
“这有什么好怕的？等着，我马上把它弄死！”
这些尘封已久的片段，此刻突然破土而出，让江凌寒心头有些发闷。
但他又很快恼羞成怒起来。
“那你现在不是没事吗？”
少年的声音陡然拔高，带着几分理直气壮：“如果不是你偷了师姐的东西，我又怎么会惩罚你？”
——可那本来就是我的东西。
苏虞累了，懒得跟他争辩，随后开始默默给自己上药。
她爹说过，无论是谁，都永远无法叫醒一个装睡的人。
幸好以前的自己，没有傻到连怎么炼药都忘记了。否则她现在，怕是连一瓶伤药都拿不出来。
少女脸色苍白，眼睫纤长浓密，脸颊带了点病态的薄红，像是风一吹就倒了。
明明只是最简单的上药动作，她都得先用指尖确认伤口的位置，再小心翼翼地把药粉撒上。

如此笨拙的模样，终于让江凌寒察觉到了不对劲。
“你的眼睛……”
苏虞上药的动作顿了顿，随即抬起头，用那双没有焦距的眼睛‘看’过去，语气冷淡。
“对啊，拜二师兄所赐——”
“我这辈子都看不见了。”
其实也没有那么严重，苏虞在心里默默补充。
好像在遇见蛋蛋的时候，被蛇毒侵蚀得昏昏沉沉的脑子，就清明了不少，连带着眼睛的胀痛也缓解了几分。
可她当然要把自己的伤势说得更严重，还恨不得大肆宣扬。
只有这样，她这身伤才没有白受。
看着眼前双目无神的少女，江凌寒喉间像是被什么东西堵住了。
方才的理直气壮，瞬间消散得无影无踪。
他张了张嘴，竟一个字也说不出来，周身的戾气渐渐褪去，只剩下一片死寂的沉默。
叶怀渊就是在这个时候出现的。
毕竟师弟闯了祸，他总得来善后。
听完前因后果后，叶怀渊猛地看向叶怀渊，胸膛剧烈起伏，竟是头一次对着他发这么大的火。
“你眼里还有没有宗门的规矩？！我平日里就是这么教导你们的？”
显然，这句责怪是针对他们两个人的。
苏虞左耳进右耳出，只当是看场戏了。
虽然这戏，挺烂的。
叶怀渊面色阴沉，只堪堪维持住平常的表情。

“这事要是传出去，外人会怎么议论凌云宗？说我们同门相残，苛待弟子？”
“师尊若是怪罪下来，又该如何是好？！”
都这时候了，叶怀渊最关心的，还是凌云宗的形象、师尊的想法和自己的面子。
content_en:
Su Yu lowered his eyes, not bothering to look at him, and said in a sarcastic tone: "Didn't you think that I would get hurt when you threw me down?"
"Don't you know...I'm most afraid of snakes?"
The girl's voice was so soft that one couldn't tell whether she was simply asking a question or expressing her grievances.
In fact, the second sentence was just Su Yu's test.
Unexpectedly, Jiang Linghan was really stunned.
Of course he knew about this. He even remembered that when he was a child, they always liked to pick fruits in the back mountains to eat.
Although they have gone away from food, the desire for food and appetite is still there.
At that time, little Su Yu was frightened by a non-venomous little green snake and cried loudly. In the end, she gave up the fruit and just huddled behind him desperately, letting him protect her.
He touched her head and said -
"What's there to be afraid of? Wait, I'll kill it right away!"
These long-dusted fragments suddenly came out at this moment, making Jiang Linghan feel a little depressed.
But he soon became angry.
"Aren't you okay now?"
The young man's voice suddenly rose, and he said with a bit of confidence: "If you hadn't stolen senior sister's things, how could I punish you?"
——But it was originally my thing.
Su Yu was too tired to argue with him, and then began to apply medicine to himself silently.
Her father said that no matter who you are, you can never wake up someone who is pretending to sleep.
Fortunately, my former self was not so stupid that I forgot how to make medicine. Otherwise, she might not even be able to get out a bottle of medicine now.
The girl's face was pale, her eyelashes were long and thick, and her cheeks were a little sickly red, as if she would fall over after being blown by the wind.
Even though it was just the simplest action of applying medicine, she had to use her fingertips to confirm the location of the wound before carefully spreading the medicine powder.
Such a clumsy appearance finally made Jiang Linghan realize that something was wrong.
"Your eyes..."
Su Yu paused while applying the medicine, then raised his head and looked over with his unfocused eyes, his tone cold.
"Yes, thanks to the second senior brother-"
"I'll never see it again in my life."
In fact, it's not that serious, Su Yu added silently in his heart.
It seemed that when he met Dandan, his brain, which had been drowsy due to snake venom, became much clearer, and the pain in his eyes also eased a bit.
But of course she wanted to make her injuries more serious and wanted to publicize them.
Only in this way, her injuries were not in vain.
Looking at the dull-eyed girl in front of him, Jiang Linghan seemed to have something blocked in his throat.
The righteousness he felt just now disappeared without a trace in an instant.
He opened his mouth, but not a word came out. The hostility around him gradually faded away, leaving only a dead silence.
Ye Huaiyuan appeared at this time.
After all, when his junior brother got into trouble, he had to come and deal with the aftermath.
After hearing the cause and effect, Ye Huaiyuan suddenly looked at Ye Huaiyuan, his chest heaving violently, and it was the first time he was so angry at him.
"Do you still have any sect rules in your eyes?! Is this how I teach you on weekdays?"
Obviously, this blame was directed at both of them.
Su Yu's ears went in and out, just like watching a show.
Although this drama is pretty bad.
Ye Huaiyuan's face was gloomy, and he could only maintain his normal expression.
"If this matter spreads out, what will outsiders say about Lingyun Sect? Say that we are members of the same sect and treat each other badly and treat our disciples harshly?"
"If Master is blamed, what should we do?!"
At this time, what Ye Huaiyuan cares most about is the image of Lingyun Sect, the master's thoughts and his own face.
